description: Turns bb into a soft dashboard: a gray shell, the thread as a raised panel, white cards and a pink-violet accent, light and dark. The composer gets even chips for project, machine and access, a gradient send button and a context line that fills as the window does. Expanded work groups read as one card with right-aligned durations and red error chips, and messages show their time on hover. A footer switch flips light, dark or system, and each chat feature can be turned off in English or Russian settings.
